name: Sentinel-3C & FLEX
location_str: Ariane Launch Area 1 (ELV) @ Guiana Space Centre, GUF
slot_a_text: Sentinel-3C is the third satellite in the Sentinel-3 constellation, which provides high-accuracy optical, radar and altimetry data for marine and land services.  The Fluorescence Explorer (FLEX) satellite is a part of ESA's Earth Explorer program. The satellite will map vegetation fluorescence to quantify photosynthetic activity.
slot_b_text: This one has moved 8 times since it was first scheduled in 2024. The current time was set 3 months ago and has held since. The window is instantaneous, so it goes on time or not at all.

program_description: Copernicus is the European Union's Earth observation programme coordinated and managed for the European Commission by the European Union Agency for the Space Programme in partnership with the European Space Agency (ESA), the EU Member States. It aims at achieving a global, continuous, autonomous, high quality, wide range Earth observation capacity.
rocket_fact: Hypergolic fuels ignite spontaneously upon contact with each other, making them reliable for restarting engines in space.
